matched_queries: UK employment guidance: Applying guaranteed-hours, shift-notice or shift-cancellation rights to agency workers and allocating responsibilities between agencies and hirers.

passages.quote:
This guidance aims to help hirers of agency workers and the recruitment sector to understand the Agency Workers Regulations that came into force on 1 October 2011. It covers the main provisions of the regulations with illustrative examples.

The regulations give agency workers the entitlement to the same or no less favourable treatment for basic employment and working conditions, if they complete a qualifying period of 12 weeks in a particular job.
